items.name: kf-gop.signed.efi
items.recorded_in: scripts/bench/windows/propimage_check.py stage_gop: the signed twin of the embedded kf-gop (crates/kf-gop-image; kf3 accepts only the embedded driver plus an Authenticode signature). MEASURED 2026-11-16: the file signed 2026-11-12 on the PC (propimage_20261112/firmware/kf-gop.signed.efi, 11224 bytes) minus its certificate table is byte-identical to the kf-gop.efi built from next af85a9353 (9216 bytes), so it is still the signed twin. Copied to private R2 as windows-proprietary/kfimg-20261112/kf-gop.signed.efi by the coordinator on 2026-11-16. It must be re-signed whenever the kf-gop sources change (a signature on any other build is refused by kf3).
